summary: The interactive terminal launcher TUI, its verbs, bare-invocation route, implementation, rendering modules, contracts, and portfolio scenario are retired; TUI-specific obligations are vacated. Store-write-free session preparation, explicit work-context reads, host placement and identity proofs retain their owners. Host tools own worktree lifecycle; authenticated per-call Project resolution uses the host-reported directory, not an ownership lookup.
title: The interactive terminal launcher is retired
